heading: Review and adjustment of classifications, grades, and pay level
lead: An employee may request at any time that the employee’s agency— The request for review and revision or adjustment shall be submitted and adjudicated in accordance with the regularly established appeals procedures of the agency.

tree.text: review the classification of the employee’s position or the grade or pay level for the employee’s position, or both; and
revise or adjust that classification, grade or pay level, or both, as the case may be.
